title: cissus inundata var. suberecta
intro: Cissus inundata var. suberecta, commonly known as Cissus suberecta, is a plant species belonging to the grape family, Vitaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving bone health, and aiding in weight management. The therapeutic actions of Cissus suberecta include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and osteoprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of Cissus suberecta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
